title: Verified agent loop: render_view + verify_part MCP tools
summary: AI agents can now SEE the parts they build (render_view returns an isometric PNG) and grade them against mecheval benchmark tasks (verify_part runs the official deterministic graders), closing the verify-and-iterate loop.
details: render_view renders an open session document through the same drafting-style isometric pipeline as the vcad-render CLI (now a reusable library exposed via the kernel WASM render_svg binding) and rasterizes to PNG via resvg, returning an MCP image block the model can inspect. verify_part writes the session document to a scratch file and shells out to the mecheval-grade binary — the exact grader the leaderboard uses, so there is one source of grading truth — relaying per-check pass/fail with measured-vs-expected details; list_eval_tasks browses the 64-task suite. The benchmark harness excludes the oracle tools during scored runs to keep the leaderboard honest. create_cad_loon's tool description now documents the full loon vocabulary (patterns, sketches, extrude/revolve/sweep/loft, assemblies) so agents stop living in primitives and booleans.
